product.ta-alphatronic-pc.summary: The Alphatronic PC brought the range to the home desk with BASIC ready at power-on.
product.ta-alphatronic-pc.history: Presented in Hanover in 1983, it was the entry model for home and small-office use. It was assembled in Japan, and HNF records a German price of DM 1,495. Science & Vie Micro dates French sales to November 1983.
product.ta-alphatronic-pc.technical.conf: Resident BASIC let users program without a disk. The manual also describes using CP/M from floppy. BASIC can select 40 or 80 columns.
product.ta-alphatronic-pc.technical.veri: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-pc.technical.limi: Verified ROMs for two boards, the UKC terminal and BiCom are preserved. MAME includes PAL, NTSC and BiCom. Boot remains to be validated in BluMach.
